title.narrative: Inclusive Eye Health - Nampula

description.narrative: Over the five-year period 2022–2026 we aim for approximately six million people living in rural areas including people with disabilities and marginalised groups to have access to quality and sustainable eye health services and restore sight to over 10,000 people in need of surgery to prevent blindness.
